## ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire

A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.

### Controls

- **F** or **Enter** — strike
- **Q** — Arcane Burst (costs 12 mana)
- **Space** — evade a guardian's telegraphed attack
- **R** — drink a healing potion
- The on-screen buttons also work with touch and mouse.

Defeat each floor guardian to ascend. Every tenth floor is a boss; every fifth floor can award a stronger sword. Earn XP to level up and receive stat points, then tap **+ Stat Points** to invest. Reach and defeat the guardian on Floor 100 to win.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the existing 100-floor browser RPG into a more complete game and fix the player-hand animation bug.

## Requirements
- Fix the character’s hand stretching downward.
- Add floors with more enemies, safe-zone floors, a shop, trading, healing items, ore drops, armor forging, and monster loot.
- Deliver a complete playable game.

## Decisions
- The existing game uses an original, canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the initial 100-floor RPG with combat, bosses, leveling, stats, potions, weapon drops, autosave, and responsive controls.
- Verified it renders and that attacking damages an enemy without browser runtime errors.

### Active
- The requested bug fixes and game-system expansion have not been started.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current combat animation and fix the stretched hand/arm pose.
2. Extend floor encounters to support multiple enemies and safe zones.
3. Add a shop/trading economy, healing supplies, monster drops including ores, and armor forging.

- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.

## Objective
- Complete the 100-floor browser RPG and fix the player’s hand stretching during attack animations.
- Validate gameplay, services, persistence, combat, and responsive controls in a browser.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Include multiple enemies per floor, safe zones, a shop, trading, healing items, ore drops, armor forging, and monster loot.

## Decisions
- Floors ending in 5 are safe waystations; floors divisible by 10 are boss floors.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added multi-enemy floors, waystation services, tonics, monster loot and ore drops, armor forging, and service UI.
- Added safe-zone rendering and null-enemy guards; fixed the slash effect to use its countdown timer.
- Reworked the sword arm into connected shoulder–elbow–wrist segments.
- Applied forged armor defense during combat and reset all progress on a new cycle.
- `node --check game.js` passes.

### Active
- Validate floor progression, combat, persistence, services, and responsive controls in a browser.
- Diagnose the browser-test fixture: the Chromium headless run reported most checks as failing, likely because the local-file test fixture did not load the saved state; the results are inconclusive.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Serve the game and browser-test fixture over HTTP, then retest waystations, multi-enemy floors, bosses, combat, and defeat/restart behavior.
2. Verify shop, loot trading, tonics, forging, persistence, and mobile layout; fix any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay systems, combat loop, persistence, and canvas rendering.
- `index.html`: combat UI, inventory, waystation services, and controls.
- `style.css`: layout, responsive rules, and service/tonic styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/ascendant-test.html`: temporary headless-browser test fixture.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. `git status --short` shows `README.md` modified and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` untracked.
- The headless Chromium test used `file:///tmp/opencode/ascendant-test.html`; checks failed for the initial floor, progression, services, and multi-enemy combat, while the restoration check passed.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the 100-floor browser RPG, including combat, services, persistence, the final boss, and responsive controls.
- Fix the player’s hand stretching during attack animations.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Include multi-enemy floors, safe zones, a shop, trading, healing items, ore drops, armor forging, and monster loot.

## Decisions
- Floors ending in 5 are safe waystations; floors divisible by 10 are boss floors.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the requested gameplay systems, safe-zone rendering, combat defense, and new-cycle reset.
- Reworked the sword arm into connected shoulder–elbow–wrist segments and fixed the slash effect timer.
- Validated combat progression, waystation services, multi-enemy combat, boss rewards, defeat recovery, save restoration, and floor-100 victory/reset in Chromium over HTTP.
- Verified mobile layout at 390px with no horizontal overflow; fixed potion hotkey markup that displayed literal `<kbd>` tags.
- `node --check game.js` passes.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. (none)

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay, combat, persistence, rendering, and potion hotkey display fix.
- `index.html`: game UI and controls.
- `style.css`: layout and responsive styles.
- `README.md`: modified project documentation.

## Important Context
- Changes remain uncommitted. `git status --short` shows `README.md` modified and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` untracked.
- Browser testing used a temporary HTTP-served fixture; the fixture was removed afterward.

## Objective
- Finish and validate the 100-floor browser RPG, including combat, services, persistence, the final boss, and responsive controls.
- Add freely assignable stat points, item rarities, and chat-enabled NPCs with stories in safe rooms.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Include multi-enemy floors, safe zones, a shop, trading, healing items, ore drops, armor forging, and monster loot.
- Let the player choose which stats receive points.
- Add an item rarity system and NPC chatbots in safe rooms that can tell stories.

## Decisions
- Floors ending in 5 are safe waystations; floors divisible by 10 are boss floors.
- The previous point allocation logic automatically chose a stat in rotation; it needs to be replaced with player-selected allocation.

## Work State
### Completed

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate the 100-floor browser RPG, including combat, services, persistence, the final boss, and responsive controls.
- Add freely assignable stat points, item rarities, and chat-enabled NPCs with stories in safe rooms.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Include multi-enemy floors, safe zones, a shop, trading, healing items, ore drops, armor forging, and monster loot.
- Let the player choose which stats receive points.
- Add a rarity system and NPC chatbots in safe rooms that can tell stories.

## Decisions
- Floors ending in 5 are safe waystations; floors divisible by 10 are boss floors.
- Stat points are allocated using per-stat `+` buttons rather than automatic rotation.
- NPC conversations and stories are implemented locally, without an external chatbot service.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented and browser-validated combat progression, waystation services, multi-enemy combat, boss rewards, defeat recovery, save restoration, and floor-100 victory/reset.
- Fixed the attack animation’s stretching sword arm and corrected the potion hotkey display.
- Verified mobile layout at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
- Added per-stat allocation controls and wired them to spend points on the selected stat.
- Added rarity-colored relic drops that grant stat bonuses, rarity labels for boss weapons, and inventory display for recent relics.
- Added three safe-room NPCs with selectable dialogue, story prompts, and advice responses; interactions are disabled outside waystations.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed after the latest changes.

### Active
- Browser-test stat allocation, rarity drops/effects and persistence, NPC chat/story interactions, and safe-room-only access.
- Inspect the responsive layout with the new inventory and NPC chat panels.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run browser tests for stat spending, relic rarity/stat effects and save restoration, and NPC selection/chat/story behavior at safe and combat floors.
2. Fix any UI, persistence, or gameplay issues found; rerun syntax and layout checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay, persistence, stat allocation, relic drops, NPC dialogue, and rendering.
- `index.html`: stat controls, inventory rarity display, and NPC chat UI.
- `style.css`: stat, rarity, and chat panel styling.
- `README.md`: project documentation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- Relic rarity currently maps to stat bonuses: common/uncommon +1, rare +2, epic +3, legendary +4; drops occur with a 36% chance or from bosses.
- No browser tests have been run for the newly added allocation, rarity, and NPC features.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate the 100-floor browser RPG, including combat, services, persistence, the final boss, and responsive controls.
- Add freely assignable stat points, item rarities, and chat-enabled NPCs with stories in safe rooms.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Include multi-enemy floors, safe zones, a shop, trading, healing items, ore drops, armor forging, and monster loot.
- Let the player choose which stats receive points.
- Add item rarities and local NPC conversations and stories in safe rooms.

## Decisions
- Floors ending in 5 are safe waystations; floors divisible by 10 are boss floors.
- Stat points are allocated using per-stat `+` buttons.
- NPC conversations and stories work locally without an external chatbot service.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented and browser-validated combat progression, waystation services, multi-enemy combat, boss rewards, defeat recovery, save restoration, and floor-100 victory/reset.
- Fixed the attack animation’s stretching sword arm and corrected the potion hotkey display.
- Verified mobile layout at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
- Added stat allocation controls, rarity-colored relic drops and stat bonuses, rarity labels, inventory display, and three safe-room NPCs with dialogue, stories, and advice.
- Latest `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Browser-test stat spending, relic rarity/effects and save restoration, NPC selection/chat/story behavior, safe-room-only access, and responsive layout with the new panels.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Browser-test the new stat allocation, rarity, persistence, and NPC features.
2. Inspect mobile and desktop layouts; fix any issues found.
3. Rerun syntax and whitespace checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay, persistence, stat allocation, relic drops, NPC dialogue, and rendering.
- `index.html`: stat controls, inventory rarity display, and NPC chat UI.
- `style.css`: stat, rarity, and chat panel styling.
- `README.md`: project documentation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- Relic drops have a 36% chance or are guaranteed from bosses; rarities grant +1 to +4 to a random stat.
- Browser tests for the newly added features have not yet been run. Chromium is available at `/usr/bin/chromium`.

+

+- **R** — drink a healing potion
+- The on-screen buttons also work with touch and mouse.
+
+Defeat each floor guardian to ascend. Every tenth floor is a boss; every fifth floor can award a stronger sword. Earn XP to level up and receive stat points, then tap **+ Stat Points** to invest. Reach and defeat the guardian on Floor 100 to win.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the vanilla browser RPG with thousands of distinct NPCs, local conversations and quests, and a working blacksmith.
- Support replaying unlocked floors without respawning defeated bosses, improve combat VFX, and preserve existing game systems.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- NPC conversations must work locally without an external chatbot service.
- Preserve combat, waystation services, stat allocation, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Generate a procedural resident population with individual identities, routines, stories, and behaviors.
- Persist defeated bosses; revisited boss floors should spawn regular encounters instead.
- Add controls for returning to previously unlocked floors.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added resident search/meet, details, quest controls, local chat, and floor selection/travel panels.
- Wired resident, quest, chat, and travel controls; removed the stale `.npc-choices` handler.
- Recorded boss defeats and cleared floors; replayed defeated boss floors spawn regular encounters.
- Counted armor crafts in `forge()` so both forging paths update smith quest progress.
- Fixed floor selector updates so the current selection is not reset each UI tick.
- `node --check game.js` passes.

### Active
- Test resident search, chat, quest completion, and persistence across reloads.
- Test forging through the service button and smith chat, including quest progress.
- Test floor travel, floor clears, and boss replay; check responsive layout and enhance combat VFX as needed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run browser-based checks for resident, quest, smith/forge, persistence, travel, and boss replay flows.
2. Check responsive layout and add or improve combat shake/VFX; incoming-hit code adds the `shake` class, but no matching CSS effect was found.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, residents, dialogue/quests, combat, persistence, travel, and canvas rendering.
- `index.html`: Resident and floor-travel controls.
- `style.css`: Layout, responsive styling, and combat effects.
- `README.md`: Game documentation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- Residents are generated for IDs 1–10,000; resident #42 is Oren, the smith.
- Chromium is available at `/usr/bin/chromium`; no `playwright`, `puppeteer`, or `jsdom` Node packages were detected.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the vanilla browser RPG with residents, local conversations and quests, a working blacksmith, replayable floors, and improved combat effects.

## Requirements
- Keep the canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- NPC conversations must work locally without an external chatbot service.
- Preserve combat, waystation services, stat allocation, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Generate residents with individual identities, routines, stories, and behaviors.
- Persist defeated bosses; revisited boss floors spawn regular encounters.
- Allow travel to previously unlocked floors.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added resident search/meet, details, quest controls, local chat, and floor selection/travel panels.
- Wired resident, quest, chat, and travel controls; removed the stale `.npc-choices` handler.
- Recorded boss defeats and cleared floors; replayed defeated boss floors spawn regular encounters.
- Counted armor crafts in `forge()` for smith quest progress through either forge path.
- Fixed floor selector updates so the current selection is not reset each UI tick.
- `node --check game.js` passes; confirmed the local server responds and ChromeDriver is ready.

### Active
- Test resident search, chat, quest completion, and persistence across reloads.
- Test forging through the service button and smith chat, including quest progress.
- Test floor travel, floor clears, and boss replay; check responsive layout.
- Add or improve combat shake/VFX; incoming-hit code adds the `shake` class, but no matching CSS effect was found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run browser checks for resident, quest, smith/forge, persistence, travel, and boss replay flows.
2. Check responsive layout and add a reduced-motion-aware combat shake effect if appropriate.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, residents, dialogue/quests, combat, persistence, travel, and canvas rendering.
- `index.html`: Resident and floor-travel controls.
- `style.css`: Layout, responsive styling, and combat effects.
- `README.md`: Game documentation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- Residents are generated for IDs 1–10,000; resident #42 is Oren, the smith.
- No browser interaction tests have run yet. The local server on port 8765 is already responding; starting another server there failed with `OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use`.

## Objective
- Redesign the existing vanilla browser RPG interface to be minimalist and beautiful.
- Add interface, monster, and character sounds.

## Requirements
- Keep the canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Keep resident conversations and quests local, without an external chatbot.
- Preserve combat, waystation services, stat allocation, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Use synthesized sounds through the Web Audio API; the game already has basic procedural audio.
- Respect reduced-motion settings for the existing combat shake effect.

## Work State
### Completed
- Resident search, conversations, quests, waystation services, floor travel/replay, and persistence are implemented.
- Verified forging through the waystation button advances Oren’s quest.
- Verified the 390×844 mobile layout has no horizontal overflow.
- Added and browser-verified a reduced-motion-aware combat shake animation.

### Active
- Redesign the interface and add distinct interface, monster, and character sound effects.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Replace the existing visual styling with a cohesive minimalist redesign while preserving all current UI controls and responsive behavior.
2. Expand the procedural audio into distinct interface, monster, and character sounds, connected to appropriate game events and the sound toggle.
3. Run JavaScript checks and browser-test core interactions, sound toggle, and mobile layout.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Existing game interface and controls.
- `style.css`: Current styling; primary target for the redesign.
- `game.js`: Game behaviors and existing procedural sound hooks.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Sound is initially off; `soundOn` and `audioHit()` exist in `game.js`, with current sound calls in attacks, dodging, and incoming damage.

## Objective
- Redesign the vanilla browser RPG interface to be minimalist and beautiful, and add interface, monster, and character sounds.

## Requirements
- Keep the canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Keep resident conversations and quests local, without an external chatbot.
- Preserve combat, waystation services, stat allocation, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Use synthesized sounds through the Web Audio API.
- Respect reduced-motion settings for the combat shake effect.
- Sound currently starts off and is controlled by the existing sound toggle.

## Work State
### Completed
- Resident search, conversations, quests, waystation services, floor travel/replay, and persistence are implemented.
- Forging through the waystation button was verified to advance Oren’s quest.
- The 390×844 mobile layout was verified to have no horizontal overflow.
- A reduced-motion-aware combat shake animation was added and browser-verified.

### Active
- Replace the current visual styling while preserving controls and responsive behavior.
- Expand procedural audio with distinct interface, monster, and character sounds, connected to game events and the sound toggle.
- Run JavaScript checks and browser-test core interactions, sound toggle, and mobile layout.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Redesign `style.css`; the attempted full-file write failed because its payload exceeded the tool output limit, and no change was made.
2. Add distinct synthesized sound effects in `game.js` and connect them to relevant interactions and events.
3. Run JavaScript checks and verify core gameplay, sound toggle, and mobile layout.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and controls.
- `style.css`: Primary target for the visual redesign.
- `game.js`: Game behavior and existing procedural audio hooks.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier status showed `README.md` modified and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` untracked.
- `game.js` has `soundOn=false`, `audioHit()`, sound calls for attacks, dodging, and incoming damage, and a `soundBtn` click handler.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e63070197ffeJqoabf9DJWImTL" state="completed">
## Likely cause

The floor dropdown’s options are modified on **every animation frame**:

- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:37`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L37) assigns `option.textContent` for every floor option each time `updateUI()` runs.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:123`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L123) calls `updateUI()` from the animation loop, so those option nodes are repeatedly changed while the native dropdown may be open.

Repeatedly updating the open select’s options is the strongest explanation for the menu popping closed or flickering, making it hard to choose a floor.

## Targeted fix suggestions

- Avoid assigning an option’s label when it hasn’t changed; compare the desired label with `option.textContent` first.
- Better, refresh the floor options only when relevant data changes—such as the unlocked-floor count or a floor’s cleared status—instead of as part of the per-frame UI update.
- If options must be rebuilt, preserve the current selection.

One separate behavior to be aware of: [`game.js:37`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L37) disables **TRAVEL** unless combat is clear or the player is at a safe floor. The select itself is not disabled; traveling during an active fight is intentionally blocked. The select’s styling is in [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css:182-184`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css#L182). No files were edited.
</subagent>

<subagent sessionID="ses_e6307018cffeH0SqiIyje2G7bU" state="completed">
## Practical recommendations

### 1. Convert the sidebar into accessible icon tabs

In `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`, keep the existing panels but group them into a few task-oriented views—for example, **Status** (profile and objective), **Build** (tower and inventory), and **World** (services, floor travel, NPC). Use icon-and-label buttons rather than icon-only controls so the navigation remains understandable.

Implement the tab bar with standard accessibility semantics: a `tablist`, buttons with `role="tab"` and `aria-selected`, and corresponding `tabpanel` sections linked by IDs. Support keyboard navigation and a visible focus state. Keep the **Continue** control outside the tab panels so it stays easy to find, and consider leaving essential status visible across tabs.

For smaller screens, use the same tabs to avoid stacking every panel into a long page. The current responsive rules in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css` already adapt the sidebar at several breakpoints; adjust those rules so the tab bar remains usable without crowding the game area.

### 2. Add localization without mixing it into game updates

The UI has hard-coded text in both the HTML and gameplay/UI code, including generated dialogue and combat messages. A practical first step is to centralize user-facing strings in locale dictionaries and provide a small translation helper with placeholders for dynamic values. Translate static labels and buttons first, then move dynamic messages to keyed strings.

Keep locale changes separate from gameplay state updates. In particular, `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js` calls `updateUI()` from the animation loop, so translating or rebuilding all UI on every tick would be unnecessary work. Apply the selected locale on initialization or when it changes, and update only dynamic values as gameplay requires.

### 3. Use the existing CSS variables for themes

`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css` already defines color custom properties in `:root`. Preserve those variable names, define alternate values under a theme selector such as `[data-theme="dark"]`, and set that attribute on the document root when the user changes themes. This keeps component styles independent of the selected palette.

Store the user’s theme and locale preferences separately from gameplay saves in `localStorage`, then apply them during startup. This avoids coupling presentation preferences to game-state serialization in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`.

No files were changed.
</subagent>

## Objective
- Refine the vanilla browser RPG interface with reliable floor selection, persisted localization and black/white themes, and compact icon navigation.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other languages; persist language and theme preferences.
- Offer black and white interface themes.
- Group panels behind accessible icon navigation for Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents.
- Preserve the canvas arena, vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Update floor option labels only when their contents change; preserve the selected floor when rebuilding options.
- Use accessible tab navigation with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language/theme selectors and five grouped tab-panel sections with tab roles and ARIA attributes.
- `game.js` has English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, preference application functions, and reads saved language/theme values.

### Active
- Fix `updateUI()` floor options, which currently rewrite every option label on each UI update, including each animation frame.
- Wire preference selectors to save changes and apply preferences at startup; finish interface translations and black/white theme styling.
- Implement accessible tab-navigation behavior and styles; verify responsive layouts and core gameplay flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update floor options only when labels or contents change, preserving the selected floor across rebuilds.
2. Connect preference selectors to persisted settings and apply preferences at startup.
3. Add theme styling and tab behavior, then test responsive layouts and gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, UI refresh loop, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel navigation, grouped panels and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Existing layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified project description.

## Important Context
- No edits were made in the latest exchange; inspection confirmed `updateUI()` rewrites every floor option’s text unconditionally.
- `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()` exist, and language/theme are read from `localStorage`, but selector wiring and startup application remain unfinished.
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified, and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.

22: A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.
23: 
24: ### Controls
25: 
26: - **F** or **Enter** — strike

20: ## ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire
21: 
22: A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.
23: 
24: ### Controls
25: 
26: - **F** or **Enter** — strike
27: - **Q** — Arcane Burst (costs 12 mana)
28: - **Space** — evade a guardian's telegraphed attack
29: - **R** — drink a healing potion
30: - The on-screen buttons also work with touch and mouse.
31: 
32: Defeat each floor guardian to ascend. Every tenth floor is a boss; every fifth floor can award a stronger sword. Earn XP to level up and receive stat points, then tap **+ Stat Points** to invest. Reach and defeat the guardian on Floor 100 to win.

20: ## ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire
21: 
22: A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.
23: 
24: ### Controls
25: 
26: - **F** or **Enter** — strike
27: - **Q** — Arcane Burst (costs 12 mana)
28: - **Space** — evade a guardian's telegraphed attack
29: - **R** — drink a healing potion
30: - The on-screen buttons also work with touch and mouse.
31: 
32: Defeat each floor guardian to ascend. Every tenth floor is a boss; every fifth floor can award a stronger sword. Earn XP to level up and receive stat points, then tap **+ Stat Points** to invest. Reach and defeat the guardian on Floor 100 to win.

- Refine the vanilla browser RPG with persistent language and light/dark theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact icon navigation while preserving gameplay and existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other languages; persist language and theme preferences.
- Offer light and dark interface themes.
- Group panels behind accessible icon navigation for Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Update floor option labels only when contents or labels change; preserve the selected floor when rebuilding.
- Use accessible tab navigation with five panel groups and keyboard support.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors, five grouped panels, and tab/tabpanel roles and ARIA attributes.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, plus `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- Saved language and theme values are validated against supported options; invalid values fall back to English and light theme.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply preferences at startup.
- Avoid unnecessary floor-option rewrites and preserve selection on rebuild.
- Add dark-theme styles and tab-switching behavior with keyboard navigation.
- Complete interface translations and verify responsive layouts and gameplay flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers that persist preferences, and apply preferences at startup.
2. Update floor options only when contents or labels change; preserve the current selection on rebuild.
3. Add theme styles and tab-switching behavior with keyboard navigation.
4. Test language switching, floor travel, tab navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, `applyTheme()`, `applyLanguage()`, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel navigation, grouped panels and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Existing layout and responsive styles; theme and panel navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified; preserve existing changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()` are defined but not called at startup; selectors have no change handlers.
- `updateUI()` runs on every animation tick and rewrites every floor-option label each time; it rebuilds options when the count changes and selects the current game floor only on rebuild.
- Floor labels currently use hardcoded English in `updateUI()` despite translation keys; Portuguese, Spanish, and French lack the `chooseFloor` key.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab-switching behavior and corresponding navigation styles are missing.
- The latest attempted edit failed because the exact text was not found; no code changes were made afterward.

+
+## ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire
+
+A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.
+
+### Controls
+
+- **F** or **Enter** — strike
+- **Q** — Arcane Burst (costs 12 mana)
+- **Space** — evade a guardian's telegraphed attack
+- **R** — drink a healing potion
+- The on-screen buttons also work with touch and mouse.
+
+Defeat each floor guardian to ascend. Every tenth floor is a boss; every fifth floor can award a stronger sword. Earn XP to level up and receive stat points, then tap **+ Stat Points** to invest. Reach and defeat the guardian on Floor 100 to win.

## Objective
- Refine the vanilla browser RPG with persistent language and light/dark theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact icon navigation while preserving gameplay and existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other languages; persist language and theme preferences.
- Offer light and dark interface themes.
- Group panels behind accessible icon navigation for Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Update floor option labels only when contents or labels change; preserve the selected floor when rebuilding.
- Use accessible tab navigation with five panel groups and keyboard support.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors, five grouped panels, and tab/tabpanel roles and ARIA attributes.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, plus `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- Saved language and theme values are validated against supported options; invalid values fall back to English and light theme.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply preferences at startup.
- Avoid unnecessary floor-option rewrites and preserve selection on rebuild; localize floor labels and complete missing translations.
- Add dark-theme styles and tab-switching behavior with keyboard navigation.
- Complete interface translations and verify responsive layouts and gameplay flows.
- English `messages.en` now includes additional dynamic-label keys; equivalent translations and their use remain pending.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers that persist preferences, and apply preferences at startup.
2. Update floor options only when contents or labels change; preserve the current selection on rebuild and localize labels.
3. Add theme styles and keyboard-accessible tab-switching behavior.
4. Complete translations, then test language switching, floor travel, tab navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, `applyTheme()`, `applyLanguage()`, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel navigation, grouped panels and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Existing layout and responsive styles; theme and panel navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified; preserve existing changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()` are defined but not called at startup; selectors have no change handlers.
- `updateUI()` runs on every animation tick, currently rewrites every floor-option label each time, rebuilds options when the count changes, and selects the current game floor only on rebuild.
- Floor labels are hardcoded in English; only English previously had `chooseFloor`.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab-switching behavior and corresponding navigation styles are missing.
- No tests or gameplay verification have been run.

20: ## ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire
21: 
22: A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.
23: 
24: ### Controls
25: 
26: - **F** or **Enter** — strike
27: - **Q** — Arcane Burst (costs 12 mana)
28: - **Space** — evade a guardian's telegraphed attack
29: - **R** — drink a healing potion
30: - The on-screen buttons also work with touch and mouse.
31:

## Objective
- Refine the vanilla browser RPG with persistent language and light/dark theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact icon navigation while preserving gameplay and existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other languages; persist language and theme preferences.
- Offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind accessible icon navigation with keyboard support.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Update floor options only when their contents or labels change; preserve the selected floor when rebuilding.
- Use accessible tab navigation with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors, five grouped panels, and tab/tabpanel roles and ARIA attributes.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, plus `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- Saved language and theme values are validated against supported options, falling back to English and light theme.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply preferences at startup in `game.js`.
- Avoid unnecessary floor-option rewrites, preserve selection on rebuild, localize floor labels, and complete translations.
- Add dark-theme styles and keyboard-accessible tab switching.
- Verify responsive layouts and gameplay flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers and apply preferences at startup in `game.js`.
2. Update floor options only when contents or labels change, preserving a valid existing selection and localizing labels.
3. Add dark-theme styles and keyboard-accessible tab switching.
4. Complete translations and test preferences, floor travel, tabs, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, `applyTheme()`, `applyLanguage()`, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel navigation, grouped panels and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Existing layout and responsive styles; theme and panel navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified; preserve existing changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyLanguage()` calls `updateUI()`, but neither preference function is called at startup; preference selectors have no change handlers.
- `updateUI()` runs on every animation tick and rewrites every floor-option label; it rebuilds options when count changes, then selects the game’s current floor only on rebuild.
- Floor-selector labels and travel status/title are hardcoded in English. Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries are partial.
- Panel roles/grouping exist, but tab switching and corresponding navigation styles are missing.
- The latest edit attempt failed with `Could not find oldString in game.js. It must match exactly, including whitespace and indentation.` No changes were made by that attempt.
- No tests or gameplay verification have been run.

## Objective
- Refine the vanilla browser RPG with persistent language and light/dark theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation while preserving gameplay and existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences.
- Offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Update floor options only when their contents or labels change; preserve a valid selection when rebuilding.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing `index.html` includes language/theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- Existing `game.js` includes partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, plus `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- Saved language/theme values are validated, defaulting to English and light.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update floor options only when contents or labels change; preserve selection and localize floor labels.
- Add dark-theme styles and keyboard-accessible tab switching.
- Expand translations and verify responsive layouts and gameplay flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Make floor-option rebuilding conditional on content/label changes, preserve valid selection, and localize labels.
3. Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching.
4. Complete translations and test preferences, floor travel, tabs, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Existing layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified; preserve existing changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyLanguage()` calls `updateUI()`, but preference functions are not called at startup and selectors have no change handlers.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick and rewrites floor-option labels; it rebuilds only when option count changes and selects the current floor only after rebuild.
- Floor-selector labels and travel status/title are hardcoded in English. Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries contain only 55 keys each, versus 108 in English.
- Tab roles/grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- No edits or tests have been made during the latest inspection.

## Objective
- Refine the vanilla browser RPG with persistent language and light/dark theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation while preserving gameplay and existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences.
- Offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Update floor options only when their contents or labels change; preserve a valid selection when rebuilding.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries; saved language/theme values are validated with English/light defaults.
- Preference application functions exist, and `updateUI()` currently updates floor options each animation tick.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update floor options only when contents or labels change, preserve valid selection, and localize floor labels and travel text.
- Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching.
- Expand translations and verify responsive layouts and gameplay flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Make floor-option rebuilding conditional on content/label changes, preserving valid selection.
3. Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching.
4. Complete translations and test preferences, floor travel, tabs, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified; preserve existing changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyLanguage()` calls `updateUI()`, but preference functions are not called at startup and selectors have no change handlers.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick and rewrites floor-option labels; it rebuilds only when option count changes and selects the current floor only after rebuild.
- Floor-selector labels and travel status/title are hardcoded in English; Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries are substantially less complete than English.
- Tab roles/grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- No edits or tests have been made during the latest inspection.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Refine the vanilla browser RPG with persistent language and light/dark theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation while preserving gameplay and existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences.
- Offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Update floor options only when their contents or labels change; preserve a valid selection when rebuilding.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved language/theme values with English/light defaults, and defines preference-application functions.
- `README.md` has existing uncommitted changes; preserve them.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Make floor-option rebuilding conditional on content/label changes, preserve valid selections, and localize floor and travel labels.
- Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching; expand translations.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor options only when needed, preserving valid selections, and localize floor/travel labels.
3. Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching; expand translations.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified; preserve existing changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyLanguage()` calls `updateUI()`, but preference functions are not called at startup and selectors have no change handlers.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options rebuild only when option count changes, labels are rewritten each tick, and selection is reset to the current floor only after a rebuild.
- Floor-selector labels and travel status/title are hardcoded in English; Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries are substantially less complete than English.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- An attempted edit to `game.js` failed because the exact source text did not match; no changes from that attempt were applied.

## Objective
- Refine the vanilla browser RPG with persistent language and light/dark preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation while preserving gameplay and existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences.
- Offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their contents or labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries; validates saved language/theme values with English/light defaults; defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- English translations include floor/travel labels and a `panelNavigation` key.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update floor options conditionally, preserving valid selections, and localize floor/travel labels.
- Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching; expand translations.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Wire language/theme change handlers and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor options only when needed, preserving valid selections, and localize floor/travel labels.
3. Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching; expand translations.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified; preserve existing changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()` exist but are not called at startup and have no preference-change handlers.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options rebuild only when option count changes, labels are rewritten each tick, and selection resets to the current floor after a rebuild.
- Floor-selector labels and travel status/title are hardcoded in English; Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries are substantially less complete than English.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- A targeted edit to `applyLanguage()` failed with `Could not find oldString in game.js. It must match exactly, including whitespace and indentation.` No file changes were made by the attempted edit.

## Objective
- Refine the vanilla browser RPG with persistent language and light/dark preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact accessible icon navigation while preserving gameplay and existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences.
- Offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their contents or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains language/theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preference values with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- English translations include floor/travel labels and a `panelNavigation` key.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update floor options conditionally, preserving valid selections, and localize floor/travel labels.
- Add dark-theme styles, keyboard tab switching, and complete translations.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor options only when option count or localized labels change; preserve a valid selection and localize floor/travel text.
3. Add dark-theme styles, accessible keyboard tab switching, and missing translations.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

20: ## ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire

22: A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.
23: 
24: ### Controls
25: 
26: - **F** or **Enter** — strike
27: - **Q** — Arcane Burst (costs 12 mana)

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences; offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update floor options conditionally, preserving a valid selection and avoiding redundant DOM updates.
- Localize floor options, travel labels/statuses, and missing translations.
- Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor options conditionally, preserving a valid selection and avoiding per-tick label rewrites.
3. Add dark-theme styles, accessible keyboard tab switching, and missing translations.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `README.md` is modified, and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()` are defined but have no change handlers and are not called at startup; startup currently runs `makeEnemy(); updateUI();`.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options rebuild only when their count changes, labels are rewritten each tick, and rebuilding selects the current floor.
- English has dynamic UI translation keys absent from Portuguese, Spanish, and French; floor and travel labels/statuses remain hardcoded in places.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- No tests have been run.

## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences; offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update floor options conditionally, preserving the selected floor and avoiding redundant label rewrites.
- Localize floor options, travel labels/statuses, and missing translations.
- Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor options only when count or localized labels change; preserve a valid selected floor.
3. Add dark-theme styles, accessible keyboard tab switching, and missing translations.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

## Important Context
- No changes were made during the latest inspection; no tests have been run.
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified, and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.

- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options rebuild only when their count changes, labels are rewritten each tick, and rebuilding selects the current floor.
- English has dynamic UI translation keys absent from Portuguese, Spanish, and French; floor and travel labels/statuses remain hardcoded in places.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences; offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update floor options conditionally, preserving the selected floor and avoiding redundant label rewrites.
- Localize floor options, travel labels/statuses, and missing translations.
- Add dark-theme styles and keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor options only when count or localized labels change; preserve a valid selected floor.
3. Add dark-theme styles, accessible keyboard tab switching, and missing translations.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

## Important Context
- No code changes or tests occurred in the latest inspection.
- Changes remain uncommitted: `README.md` is modified, and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()` have no change handlers and are not called at startup; startup currently runs `makeEnemy(); updateUI();`.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options rebuild only when their count changes, labels are rewritten each tick, and rebuilding selects the current floor.
- English has dynamic UI translation keys absent from Portuguese, Spanish, and French; floor and travel labels/statuses remain hardcoded in places.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- A recent Node script intended to extract translation keys failed because its regex returned `null` (`TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading '1')`).

## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences; offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.
- English floor/travel translation keys were added; Portuguese translations were started for floor/travel statuses and navigation labels.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update `updateUI()` to conditionally rebuild localized floor options while preserving a valid selection.
- Complete missing translations, add dark-theme styles, and implement accessible keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor-option rebuilding to react only to count or label changes while preserving a valid selection.
3. Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and accessible keyboard tab switching.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `game.js`, `index.html`, `style.css`, and several other files are untracked, and `README.md` is modified. Preserve existing work.
- Preference handlers are still absent; startup currently runs `makeEnemy();updateUI();`.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options currently rebuild only when their count changes, labels are rewritten each tick, and selection is restored only on rebuild.
- Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries lack many English keys; fallback is English. Several floor, travel, and status strings remain hardcoded.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- No tests have been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences; offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update `updateUI()` to conditionally rebuild localized floor options while preserving a valid selection.
- Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and accessible keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor-option rebuilding to react only to count or label changes while preserving a valid selection.
3. Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and accessible keyboard tab switching.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `game.js`, `index.html`, `style.css`, and several other files are untracked, and `README.md` is modified.
- Preference handlers are absent; startup currently runs `makeEnemy();updateUI();`.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options currently rebuild only when their count changes, labels are rewritten each tick, and selection is restored only on rebuild.
- Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries lack many English keys; fallback is English. Several floor, travel, and status strings remain hardcoded.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- An attempted exact edit of `applyLanguage()` failed because the text did not match; no changes were made by that attempt.
- No tests have been run.

## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences; offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` has partial English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update `updateUI()` to conditionally rebuild localized floor options while preserving a valid selection.
- Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and accessible keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor-option rebuilding to react only to count or label changes while preserving a valid selection.
3. Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and accessible keyboard tab switching.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified; its changes are uncommitted.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `game.js`, `index.html`, `style.css`, and several other files are untracked, and `README.md` is modified.
- Preference handlers are absent; startup currently runs `makeEnemy();updateUI();`.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options currently rebuild only when their count changes, labels are rewritten each tick, and selection is restored only on rebuild.
- Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries lack many English keys; fallback is English. Several floor, travel, and status strings remain hardcoded.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- An attempted exact edit of `applyLanguage()` failed because the text did not match; no changes were made by that attempt.
- No tests have been run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences; offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` defines English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries with English fallback, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update `updateUI()` to conditionally rebuild floor options when count or localized labels change while preserving selection.
- Complete translations and dark-theme styles.
- Add accessible keyboard tab switching and navigation styles.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor-option rebuilding to react only to count or label changes while preserving selection.
3. Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and accessible keyboard tab switching.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified, and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- Preference handlers are absent; startup currently runs `makeEnemy();updateUI();`, without applying saved preferences.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options rebuild only when their count changes, labels are rewritten each tick, and selection is restored only on rebuild.
- Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries have incomplete coverage; fallback is English. Several floor, travel, and status strings remain hardcoded.
- Tab roles and panel grouping exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- `node --check game.js` completed without errors; no gameplay or browser tests have been run.
