## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences; offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` defines English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries with English fallback, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update floor-option rebuilding to react only to count or label changes while preserving selection.
- Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and accessible keyboard tab switching and navigation styles.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor-option rebuilding to compare expected localized labels and preserve the current valid selection.
3. Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and accessible keyboard tab switching.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified, and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- Preference handlers are absent; startup currently runs `makeEnemy();updateUI();`, without applying saved preferences.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options currently rebuild only when their count changes and rewrite labels every tick.
- Translation coverage is incomplete: English has 116 keys, Portuguese 76, and Spanish/French 55 each; missing keys fall back to English.
- Tab and tabpanel roles exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- `node --check game.js` passed; gameplay and browser tests have not been run.

## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences; offer light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors and five grouped tab/tabpanel sections.
- `game.js` defines English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries with English fallback, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Rebuild floor options only when count or expected localized labels change; preserve the current valid selection.
- Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor-option rebuilding to compare expected localized labels and preserve the current valid selection.
3. Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and keyboard-accessible tab switching.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified, and `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- The latest activity inspected files only; no implementation changes or gameplay/browser tests have been made.
- Preference helper functions exist, but no change handlers are wired and startup does not apply the saved preferences.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options rebuild only when their count changes and rewrite labels every tick.
- Translation coverage is incomplete: English has 116 keys, Portuguese 76, and Spanish/French 55 each; missing keys fall back to English.
- Tab and tabpanel roles exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- `node --check game.js` passed previously.

## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences, with light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors, five grouped tab/tabpanel sections, and translation markers.
- `game.js` has English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries with English fallback, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` localizes panel-tab titles and the tablist’s accessible name.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update `updateUI()` floor-option rebuilding to compare option count and localized labels while preserving the current valid selection.
- Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update the floor-selector rebuild logic in `updateUI()` to compare count and localized labels, preserving the current valid selection.
3. Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and keyboard-accessible tab switching.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified in the working tree; preserve existing user changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.

- Translation coverage is incomplete; missing keys fall back to English. Tab and tabpanel roles exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- `node --check game.js` passed previously; no gameplay or browser tests have been run.

+
+A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.

+
+- **F** or **Enter** — strike
+- **Q** — Arcane Burst (costs 12 mana)
+- **Space** — evade a guardian's telegraphed attack
+- **R** — drink a healing potion
+- The on-screen buttons also work with touch and mouse.
+
+Defeat each floor guardian to ascend. Every tenth floor is a boss; every fifth floor can award a stronger sword. Earn XP to level up and receive stat points, then tap **+ Stat Points** to invest. Reach and defeat the guardian on Floor 100 to win.

## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences, with light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors, five tab/tabpanel sections, and translation markers.
- `game.js` defines English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preference values with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` updates marked text, document language, accessible labels, and panel-tab titles.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update `updateUI()` floor-option rebuilding to compare option count and localized labels while preserving the current valid selection.
- Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor-selector rebuilding in `updateUI()` to compare count and localized labels while preserving the current valid selection.
3. Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and keyboard-accessible tab switching.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified in the working tree; preserve existing user changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()` exist, but preference-change handlers and startup application are absent.
- `updateUI()` runs each animation tick; floor options currently rebuild only when option count changes and rewrite labels every tick.
- Translation coverage is incomplete: English has about 116 keys, Portuguese 76, and Spanish/French 55 each; missing keys fall back to English.
- Tab and tabpanel roles exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing.
- `node --check game.js` passed previously; no gameplay or browser tests have been run.

20: ## ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire
21: 
22: A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.
23: 
24: ### Controls
25: 
26: - **F** or **Enter** — strike
27: - **Q** — Arcane Burst (costs 12 mana)
28: - **Space** — evade a guardian's telegraphed attack
29: - **R** — drink a healing potion
30: - The on-screen buttons also work with touch and mouse.
31: 
32: Defeat each floor guardian to ascend. Every tenth floor is a boss; every fifth floor can award a stronger sword. Earn XP to level up and receive stat points, then tap **+ Stat Points** to invest. Reach and defeat the guardian on Floor 100 to win.

## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences, with light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains language and theme selectors, five tab/tabpanel sections, and translation markers.
- `game.js` contains English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` updates marked text, document language, accessible labels, and panel-tab titles.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update `updateUI()` floor-option rebuilding to compare option count and localized labels while preserving a valid selection.
- Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.
2. Update floor-selector rebuilding in `updateUI()` to compare count and localized labels while preserving a valid selection.
3. Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and keyboard-accessible tab switching.
4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.
- `README.md`: Modified in the working tree; preserve existing user changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- Recent inspection made no code changes.
- Preference-change handlers and startup application are absent. `applyLanguage()` calls `updateUI()`.
- Floor options currently rebuild only when option count changes; labels are rewritten on every `updateUI()` tick.
- Translation coverage is incomplete; missing keys fall back to English.
- Tab and tabpanel roles exist, but tab switching and navigation styles are missing; inactive tabpanels use `hidden`.
- `node --check game.js` passed previously; no gameplay or browser tests have been run.

## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and theme preferences, with light and dark themes.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count or localized labels change, preserving a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has language and theme selectors, five tab/tabpanel sections, and translation markers.
- `game.js` has English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French dictionaries, validates saved preferences with English/light defaults, and defines `applyTheme()` and `applyLanguage()`.
- `applyLanguage()` updates marked text, document language, accessible labels, and panel-tab titles.
- Inspected relevant markup, styles, preference initialization, floor-selector logic, event handlers, and startup code.

### Active
- Wire and persist preference changes and apply saved preferences at startup.
- Update `updateUI()` floor-option rebuilding to compare option count and localized labels while preserving a valid selection.
- Complete translations, dark-theme styles, and keyboard tab switching.
- Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Add language/theme change handlers, persist values, and apply saved preferences at startup.

4. Test preferences, floor travel, navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styles; theme and panel-navigation styles remain to be added.

python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('game.js').read()
for lang in ['en','pt','es','fr']:
 m=re.search(r'\b'+lang+r':\{',s)
 start=m.end(); depth=1; i=start
 while depth and i<len(s):
  if s[i]=='{':depth+=1
  elif s[i]=='}':depth-=1
  i+=1
 body=s[start:i-1]
 keys=re.findall(r"(?:^|,)([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*):",body)
 print(lang,len(keys),','.join(keys))
PY

+
+### Controls
+

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and light/dark theme preferences.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count changes; update labels only when they differ and preserve a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups; arrow keys and Home/End move focus and activate tabs.
- Default invalid or missing saved preferences to English and light theme.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added language and theme selectors, five tab/tabpanel sections, translations, preference persistence, theme styles, and keyboard navigation.
- Updated floor-option logic to avoid unnecessary label rewrites and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- `node --check game.js` completed without errors.

### Active
- Complete Spanish and French localization; dictionaries have 113 English keys, while Spanish and French are missing many dynamic UI strings. French also has a capitalization typo in `arcaneBurst`.
- Test preference persistence, floor selection/travel, keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add complete Spanish and French translations for missing dictionary keys and dynamic UI text.
2. Run browser/gameplay checks for saved preferences, floor selection/travel, keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay, and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Themes, panel navigation, and responsive styles.
- `README.md`: Modified RPG documentation; preserve existing changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- Chromium is available; no Playwright, Puppeteer, or jsdom package was found. No browser or gameplay tests have been run.

## Objective
- Refine the browser RPG with persistent language and theme preferences, reliable floor selection, and compact, accessible icon navigation without disrupting gameplay or existing saves.

## Requirements
- Prevent floor-selector flicker and preserve a valid selection when options are rebuilt.
- Support Portuguese and other available languages; persist language and light/dark theme preferences.
- Group Status, Quests, Tower, Shop, and Residents behind keyboard-accessible icon navigation.
- Preserve gameplay systems, quests, combat, services, stats, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Rebuild floor options only when their count changes; update labels only when they differ and preserve a valid selection.
- Use accessible tabs with five panel groups; arrow keys and Home/End move focus and activate tabs.
- Default invalid or missing saved preferences to English and light theme.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added language and theme selectors, five tab/tabpanel sections, translations, preference persistence, theme styles, and keyboard navigation.
- Updated floor-option logic to avoid unnecessary label rewrites and preserve valid selections when options are rebuilt.
- `node --check game.js` completed without errors.

### Active
- Complete Spanish and French localization; their dictionaries are missing many dynamic UI strings. French `arcaneBurst` has a capitalization typo.
- Test preference persistence, floor selection/travel, keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Add missing Spanish and French translations and fix the French `arcaneBurst` typo; a recent attempt to insert translations failed because the exact source text did not match.
2. Run browser/gameplay checks for saved preferences, floor selection/travel, keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, and core gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Preferences, translations, UI updates, floor selector, gameplay, and persistence.
- `index.html`: Preferences, accessible panel markup, and translation markers.
- `style.css`: Themes, panel navigation, and responsive styles.
- `README.md`: Modified RPG documentation; preserve existing changes.

- Changes are uncommitted. `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- No browser or gameplay tests have been run; Chromium is available, but Playwright, Puppeteer, and jsdom were not found.
